hakone-tozan.title: Stay near the route
hakone-tozan.description: Gora is the top of the line. Stay there and you can ride the switchbacks early, before the day-trip crowds.

sagano-gorge.title: Stay in Kyoto for this day trip
sagano-gorge.description: Torokko Saga is next to JR Saga-Arashiyama, a direct JR ride from Kyoto Station, so a hotel by Kyoto Station makes an easy base.

yurikamome-night.title: Stay near the route
yurikamome-night.description: Ariake, Odaiba and Toyosu are on the waterfront section of this route.

kurobe-gorge.title: Stay at the start of the line
kurobe-gorge.description: The trolley train starts at Unazuki, a hot-spring town. Staying there makes a morning departure easy.

senmo-drift-ice.title: Stay at the start of the line
senmo-drift-ice.description: The Senmo Line starts at Abashiri, the usual base for drift-ice season on the Sea of Okhotsk.

tadami-river.title: Stay at the start of the line
tadami-river.description: Tadami Line trains start from Aizu-Wakamatsu and are few, so staying in town makes the early train easier.

gono-coast.title: Stay on the coast
gono-coast.description: Fukaura is on the coastal stretch of the line. It has only a handful of places to stay, so book early.

furano-biei-flowers.title: Stay near the route
furano-biei-flowers.description: Furano is the base for the flower fields and the seasonal Norokko train.

tohoku-iwate.title: Stay at the end of the line
tohoku-iwate.description: Aomori Station is a short local ride from Shin-Aomori, where the Tohoku Shinkansen ends.

joetsu-snow.title: Stay in snow country
joetsu-snow.description: Echigo-Yuzawa is a Joetsu Shinkansen stop in snow country, with hot-spring hotels near the station.
